rewards.title: Community Karma & Officer Recognition
rewards.subtitle: Auditable points credited for verified reporting, photographic accuracy, and on-ground audits.
rewards.noOfficerLeaderboard: No officer resolution records found for this area.
rewards.guideline1Desc: Every resolution reported by an operator must include clear on-site photographs proving the hazard or waste has been cleared before case closure.
rewards.guideline2Desc: Forwarded tickets require prompt acknowledgement. Operators maintaining fast turnaround rates receive higher standing in the performance rankings.
rewards.guideline3Desc: Citizens possess dispute rights. If a closed report is challenged with contrary ground evidence, supervisory review is immediately triggered.
rewards.currentRank: Rank reflects recorded contributions and configured reward rules.
rewards.antiSpam: Karma cannot be purchased or fabricated. Points are cryptographically credited only upon ground verification of reports.
rewards.ledgerSub: Auditable ledger entries linked to verified case IDs
rewards.noHistory: No karma entries yet. Report genuine civic issues to earn verified points.
